reason: Conversation 1 opened with the right first step (check doors and food), correctly identified the ajar drawer as the cause, and ended with a sound conclusion that the freezer is working and nothing needs doing. It lost credibility mid-way by wrongly calling the recovering '-9' an internal fault, speculating about defrost heaters, sensors and control boards, and asking the tenant to unplug for 24 hours, and it never mentioned the alarm-off button. Conversation 2 never engaged with the actual symptom: it treated an alarm beep as a mechanical noise, ignored the customer's volunteered drawer-ajar fact and the flashing -9, and robotically repeated an unnecessary unplug-and-pull-out instruction three times while the customer objected about food loss, offering no diagnosis at all.
